tasks.final_text: The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka. It is located in teh oldest remaining Dutch building of the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building build in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.
